about: Reconstructed scripted story scenes (no fight, or a fight followed by scripted stages). The original server drove their stages with an encounter script the client does not ship. Each scene is a sequence of steps; a step names the DungeonQuestConfig quest the tracker shows (var 10001) and its goal counter (var 10003), the scene actors the server shows during it (client NPCConfig ids at scene-editor points, with the buffs that open their interactions), an optional story the client plays (dungeon var 100020016), the client events that complete it, and an optional teleport after it. A fight step instead names its monsters ("spawns": client NPCConfig templates at server spawn points) and completes when they are all killed. A step may say ChatConfig story lines ("lines" at its start, "doneLines" when it completes; a type-2 bubble names its speaker, one of the step's actors or monsters). A step may put its players on the client's slide ("slide", speeds in m/s) until it completes; an actor interaction that is a vehicle ride (GameplayStatusConfig type 3) seats the player on that actor until the step completes; "fallback" completes a step by itself after its time (from the step's start, or from "mount"), optionally moving the players to a point. A won scene with "next" goes straight on to that scene. A quest of the scene that only a branch the reconstruction cannot reach would show is listed under "unplayed" with its reason. Every decision carries its reason and the scene its confidence; what is guessed is listed per scene. Switch: Ro3Emu:ReconstructedDungeons. Never mixed into client data.

contract.interaction: 32700 NpcInteractionReq {npc_uid, interaction_id} on a scene actor: the client sends it from LC_DAL_Interact.SendNPCInteractionReq when the player presses the interaction's skill button (InteractMode 3 ClickSkillIcon), walks into range (2 AutoInteractWhenInRange) or a dialogue option runs action 211 TriggerNpcInteract (LC_InteractActions.lua:5672-5698). The interaction must be one of the actor's NPCConfig _iInteractID; the server answers 32700 with the request echoed (LC_InteractManager._onInteractResponse then runs the client-hosted actions, e.g. 53 NPCInteractDialogue).
contract.message: The NPCInteractConfig _iEXECAction ["210", id, ...] of that interaction: ActionConfig 210 SendDungeonMessage is server-hosted (_iEXECHost 1), so the client never runs it; it is the dungeon script's own message id (LC_InteractManager.lua:1975-2030 runs only client/all-hosted actions).
contract.gate: An interaction's _iNPCCondition 1004 CheckHaveBuff (LC_CommonCondition.lua:180-196) asks whether the actor carries a BuffConfig group (_iBuffID). The client shows the button only then, so the step that waits on an interaction gives its actor that buff.
contract.story: Dungeon var 100020016 (DungeonVariableFunctionConfig: start function PlayCutSceneStory, array) with [plot] makes the client play PlotInterpretation <plot> (LC_DunGeon_Actions.lua:3476-3490, LC_CutSceneManager.PlayStory). At its end (also when skipped) the plot's action 601 VideoPerformEndClient sends 84011 PlotActingEnd {plotId} (LC_GuildServer.PlotActionEnd), its action 150 PlotActingTrigger sends 84012 {plotId} (LC_TaskHelper.PlotActingTriggerReq), and 32709 follows; either one completes the step, neither expects a reply. Sent once in a 30404 DungeonEventDungeonVarChange: LC_DunGeon_Base._pushDungeonVars calls the function on every push, so it is never kept in the 30401 snapshot.
contract.region: The scene editor's server regions (regionType 2; no client consumer registers them with LC_TriggerAreaManager, so the client never reports them): the server tests the participant's walked position with LC_AreaHelper.CheckInArea's geometry (shapeType 1 circle radius = length, 2 rectangle length x width turned by direction).
contract.point: No region exists; the participant's walked position within radius metres of the scene-editor point (inferred).
contract.guide: Dungeon var 10021 PGuideWayList (LC_DunGeon_VarDefine, kProcessComp GuideGfx) lists scene-editor guide points (m_kGuidePoints); LC_SceneCom_GuideGfx, a default component of every scene (Lua_SceneComponentConfigExt), draws each one's pointList as a guide arrow line and removes the ones a new list leaves out. Sent in a 30404 DungeonEventDungeonVarChange when the step starts and, empty, when it completes; also kept in the 30401 snapshot while the step runs.
